description: Fetch the full content of a single TechCrunch article by URL (or slug). Returns the complete body text (both HTML and plain text), author name with a profile link usable by techcrunch/get-author, publish/modified dates, excerpt, featured image, editorial category slugs, and topic tag slugs (usable by techcrunch/get-topic). Powered by the public WordPress REST API. TechCrunch has no comment system, so no comment options exist. No authentication required.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full article URL (https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/13/some-article-slug/) or just the slug ("some-article-slug"). URLs come from techcrunch/get-feed, get-topic, search, get-author, or get-popular results.
